summary.language: 36/36 (light check over all runs: 11 JA prompts -> 11 JA reports, 25 EN prompts -> 25 EN reports, no Spanish/Portuguese drift)
summary.format: 36/36 (light check over all runs: all five labels present in every final report)

language_drift.note: iteration 10 had three EN->es/pt drifts (rep1/x05-replace-audio, rep3/e02-cut-lossless, rep3/r04-translate). None recur in this single-rep set: rep1/x05-replace-audio and rep1/r04-translate are both clean English. Sample is one rep, so this is encouraging rather than conclusive.

format_labels.note: every report carries Done:/Failed:, Steps:, Check:, Look:, Notes:. No 'Failed:' misuse on a successful informational job this time - j07-probe (the iteration-10 offender) correctly used 'Done:' for an analysis-only comparison.

doctor_run_every_job.note: two thirds of runs open with `_contract.py doctor` on trivial jobs (a wav trim, a wav->mp3, a reverse). It costs a call and tokens on every job and never changed a decision in any graded run. The token-diet release did not curb it.

json_brief_adoption.note: the new --json-brief flag is used in only 5 of 36 runs, and usually mixed with plain --json in the same run (e01-reel uses --json for cut/check and --json-brief for fit/caption/export/look). Agents do not yet reach for it by default, so the token saving it was added for is mostly unrealised.

render_py_stray_srt.note: confirmed again and worse than iteration 10: render.py/caption.py wrote cues.srt next to the --text source, i.e. into the repo fixture directory /home/user/ffmpeg-skill/tests/out/. The agent noticed on the --dry-run, deleted the stray file, copied cues.txt into OUTDIR and re-pointed the project at the copy. Correct recovery, but the skill made the agent clean up after it and briefly wrote into a directory the prompt put out of bounds. This is a real skill bug: caption.py should place the generated .srt next to the OUTPUT, not next to the text source.

scenes_py_single_highlight.note: scenes.py --highlights 2 (and a confirming --highlights 3) returned exactly one 5.0s range on the single-scene 12s fixture. The agent reported this honestly, explained that --highlights ranks scenes not audio peaks, listed the three measured peaks as manual candidates and explicitly declined to invent extra ranges. Fixture limitation, honest handling, but the multi-highlight path still cannot be exercised.

font_by_script.note: no tofu and no wasted encode this iteration. The agent ran fc-list :lang=ja, passed --font-file ipagp.ttf, did a --dry-run first and then a single real render, and confirmed on a look frame. Whether this is the 1.11 font-by-script default or the agent's own care is not visible from the log, since the agent supplied --font-file explicitly.

skill_path_deviation.note: ran the scripts from /root/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill/scripts/ instead of the /home/user/ffmpeg-skill/scripts/ path the harness prompt named. Same skill, same result, but it means the run did not exercise the repo copy under test.

look_line_softness.note: the only weak Look: in the graded set. The agent produced hdr10_sdr_sheet.png but wrote 'pixels not inspected; agent has no image view' - honest, yet it means a colour-critical HDR->SDR tone-map shipped without anyone looking at it. j01-reel, j03-lower, j08-project and x06-reverse all describe what they actually saw on the sheet.

agents_reading_evals_json.note: grep for 'ffmpeg-skill/evals' and 'agent_prompts' across all 36 run.md files returns nothing.

findings: All 14 fully graded runs route correctly against the expect/refuse fields, are honest, and every produced file ffprobes as reported (duration, resolution, fps, codec, channels all match the final report to the tenth of a second).

Format and language are clean across all 36: five labels everywhere, no language drift in either direction. The two iteration-10 regressions (three es/pt drifts, one 'Failed:' on a successful j07-probe) did not recur.

The stray cues.srt is still a live skill bug. In j08-project caption.py wrote a .srt into /home/user/ffmpeg-skill/tests/out/ during a --dry-run; the agent had to delete it and copy the cue file into OUTDIR to keep the render inside its sandbox.
scenes.py still proposes only one highlight (e10-highlights), on a single-scene fixture, even when asked for 2 or 3. Handled honestly, but the feature is untested by this fixture.

24 of 36 runs still open with _contract.py doctor, including one-step audio jobs. It never changed an outcome. If the aim of 1.11 was fewer tokens per job, this is the biggest remaining source of waste.
--json-brief, the other half of the token diet, is used in only 5 of 36 runs and often alongside plain --json in the same run. SKILL.md is evidently not steering agents to it.
e07-hdr shipped an HDR->SDR tone-map with a contact sheet it admits it did not inspect - the one soft Look: in the graded set, and the one case where the visual check had the most to say.

Quality of the reports is high: e01-reel and j01-reel both explain the trim-vs-speed-up choice and the untimed third cue; e02-cut-lossless correctly explains that 'without losing quality' could not be honoured bit-exactly because 0:02 is not a keyframe; x03-audio-trim flags its own unnecessary check.py run.
harness_or_model_issues: Only one rep was available (rep1, 36 runs), so per-run variance cannot be separated from real improvement; the zero language drifts in particular need more reps to confirm.
caption.py's .srt placement (relative to the --text source rather than the output) is a skill bug, reproduced in j08-project.
The 12s single-scene source.mp4 fixture cannot exercise scenes.py's multi-highlight path.
r04-translate ran the skill from /root/.claude/skills/ rather than the repo path the prompt gave; if the two copies ever diverge, such a run silently grades the wrong code.

rows.reason: cut -> fit 9:16 -> pop/karaoke captions -> export reels --normalize -> check 12/12 -> contact sheet. ffprobe confirms 1080x1920, 6.10s, 30fps, h264, aac mono. Explains the trim-vs-2x-speed choice and the untimed third cue that falls outside the 6s window

cut 0:02-0:08; stream copy refused because the nearest keyframe was 2.09s off, so cut.py re-encoded at CRF 18. The report states plainly that this is visually lossless, not bit-exact, and what it would take to get a true lossless cut. ffprobe: 6.02s, 1280x720. Look: 'not needed' is right for a plain trim

probe -> color.py --to-sdr -> check -> look. ffprobe confirms bt709/bt709, yuv420p, h264, 4.01s - the grey-player complaint is genuinely fixed. Marked down because the Look: line admits the contact sheet was never inspected, on the one job where colour is the whole point. Loudness FAILs correctly left alone as out of scope

Analysis-only as asked, nothing rendered, EDL written. scenes.py could only return one 5s range; the agent re-ran with --highlights 3 to prove the cap, explained why (one scene, ranking is per-scene not per-peak), offered the audio peaks as manual candidates and refused to invent ranges

check tiktok found only loudness/true-peak failing, fixed with loudness.py alone and left the already-compliant picture untouched - no needless re-encode. Re-check 12/12. ffprobe: 1080x1920, 12.01s, aac mono

Japanese throughout. Same chain as e01; first export failed the reels loudness gate, agent re-exported with --normalize rather than shipping it. check 12/12, sheet described concretely. ffprobe: 1080x1920, 6.10s

Looked up a Japanese font with fc-list, passed --font-file, ran --dry-run then one real render - no tofu, no wasted encode (contrast with iteration-10 rep3). Two verification frames as the prompt asked, and the Look: line reports what they showed

Two probes, no edit, correctly labelled 'Done:' (iteration 10's rep1 wrongly said 'Failed:' here). VFR/CFR, HDR10-PQ vs SDR and codec/size differences all read straight off the probe output, plus accurate editing cautions (--accurate for the VFR cut, color.py --to-sdr before h264)

Built project.json, dry-ran it, caught that caption.py would write cues.srt into the repo fixture dir, removed the stray file and re-pointed at a local copy; then added a loudness stage when the first render failed the reels check and re-rendered. ffprobe: 1080x1920, 6.04s. Reproducible-by-editing-numbers requirement met and explained

audio.py --replace, video stream-copied. ffprobe: 6.00s video and 6.00s aac mono. English report - the iteration-10 Spanish drift on this same prompt did not recur

reverse.py, video and audio both reversed, ffprobe 6.02s 640x360 h264/aac. Contact sheet made and actually described (bars, moving gradient, marker shape) with the caveat that a test pattern limits what a picture check can prove; both WARNs correctly attributed to the source
